questions.question:
In this question, a statement is followed by two courses of action, numbered I and II. You must assume everything in the statement to be true and on the basis of the information given in the statement, decide which course of action/s logically follows for pursuing.

**Statement:** There is a large increase in migration of villagers to urban areas as repeated crop failure has put them into financial problems.

**Course of action:**

I. The villagers should be provided with an alternate source of income in their villages which will make them stay there only.

II. To ensure their survival, the migrated villagers should be given access to all housing options in urban areas.
questions.solution:
The given statement highlights the reason for the large increase in migration of villagers to urban areas. Based on this, we can evaluate the two courses of action:

Course of action I: The villagers should be provided with an alternate source of income in their villages which will make them stay there only. This course of action seems logical and appropriate as providing an alternate source of income in their villages would help them stay in their villages instead of migrating to urban areas. This can also help in reducing the pressure on urban areas and improving the overall living conditions of the villagers in their own villages.

Course of action II: To ensure their survival, the migrated villagers should be given access to all housing options in urban areas. This course of action is not a practical solution as providing access to all housing options in urban areas may not be possible for the authorities. It may also not solve the root cause of the problem, which is the repeated crop failure leading to financial problems. Moreover, providing housing options to migrants may lead to the creation of slums and other social problems in urban areas.

Therefore, only course of action I logically follows for pursuing.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some chairs are beds.

Some tables are desks.

All beds are tables.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some chairs are tables.

II. Some desks are beds.

III. Some desks are chairs.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

Some chairs are beds.

Some tables are desks.

All beds are tables.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/957929d7b55657187d1531e8f7cafb8f1488b52153539334b79248e22c0a24c9.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some chairs are tables - True (Because, Those part of Chairs which is Beds is also Tables).

II. Some desks are beds - False (Because, No definite relation given between Desks and Beds, so it can be possible only).

III. Some desks are chairs - False (Because, No definite relation given between Desks and Chairs, so it can be possible only).

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
In a company, seven employees A, B, C, M, K, L and O work on 7 different levels (1 being the highest and 7 being the lowest level). B is above C and C is above just two employees. There are more than four employees above M. B is one level above A and one level below K. L is at level 7. K is below O.

How many employees are above A?
questions.solution:
Step 1: L is at level 7.

Step 2: There are more than four employees above M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ac965713e98f52681157feb353f9c02aaa0bc2ec04f4d15db8ddda3b47bd765.png] After placing L, there are only 6 spots left and we have to place M below more than four i.e. 5. So we place M at 6th.

Step 3: B is above C and C is above just two employees.

Step 4: B is one level above A and one level below K.

Step 5: K is below O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7677d99b967a110889a0ac3661977689b868b63ccf916419072a38318cd9321.png] 

C is above only 2, thus it is placed at 5th ; B is above C and one level above A and therefore A is placed at 4th and B at 3rd ; K is one level above B and below O so we place K at 2ⁿd and O at 1st.

Now we can see **there are employees above A.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All squares are rectangles.

2. All rectangles are polygons.

**Conclusions:**

I. Square is not a polygon.

II. Square is both rectangle and polygon.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
Statements:

1. All squares are rectangles.

2. All rectangles are polygons.

According to the given statement, the Venn diagram is as follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39373941df0f10a729a40763a2dcf14ae52ba112ee431650fe402917d4e0ac05.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Square is not a polygon. (False, as all squares are rectangles and all rectangles are polygon. So all squares are polygon)

II. Square is both rectangle and polygon. (True, as all squares are rectangles and all rectangles are polygon. So all squares are polygon)

Hence, Only conclusion II follows.

questions.question: Each of the letters in the word 'LASTING' is arranged in the English alphabetical order. Given word: 'LASTING'

Each of the letters in the word 'LASTING' is arranged in the English alphabetical order.

LASTING → A**G**I**L**NTS

The letter which is second from the left end = **G**

The one which is fourth from the right end = **L**

**Thus, Four **letters (G, __**H, I, J, K**__, L) are there in the English alphabetical series between the letter which is second from the left end and the one which is fourth from the right end in the new letter-cluster thus formed.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Four".**

questions.question: Choose the odd one out of the given options.
questions.solution:
The logic is:

3) JKV → J = 10, K = 11, V = 22 and 10 + 11 + 22 = 43

Hence, ‘LNM’ is the odd one out.

questions.question: In a code language, 'DENT' is written as '51' and 'LOAD' is written as '40'. How will 'COST' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00dad8e43b583eeeaaa65e5198ec5be638bf30edbd9184dca18e0a73828429e0.png] 

**Pattern: **Eight has been added to the sum of the positional value of all the letters of the word.

DENT → 51

4 + 5 + 14 + 20 **+ 8 **= 51

LOAD → 40

12 + 15 + 1 + 4 **+ 8 **= 40

Similarly, 

code for COST will be:

3 + 15 + 19 + 20 **+ 8 **= 65

Hence, **65 **is correct.
